title: Jubilant Jerked Slovakian Potato Gratin
description: A savory and light Slovakian dish featuring starch, made with katsuramuki-cut potatoes and Whole30-friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This gratin is cooked to perfection in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the katsuramuki-cut potatoes with coconut oil, jerk seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Arrange the potato slices in a terracotta dish, overlapping them slightly to form a solid layer.
Pour the chicken broth over the potatoes, making sure they are all submerged.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the gratin hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
